prompt:
9:16 vertical, ultra-realistic indoor fashion photography, featuring a single adult woman.
Subject: A clearly adult 26-year-old East Asian woman with a slender, elongated oval face and a mature, cool, sophisticated feminine aura.
Hairstyle: A voluminous short black bob with airy, wispy bangs.
Makeup: Muted grayish-purple eyeshadow, delicate cat-eye eyeliner, and cool pink lips.
Outfit: A fitted burgundy knit dress that naturally follows her body contours.
Pose and Expression: Reclining diagonally against a modular sofa, with both legs naturally bent. She turns her head over her shoulder to look directly into the camera, maintaining a relaxed, effortless expression.
Setting: A vintage Taiwanese apartment with a nostalgic cinematic atmosphere, featuring sheer white curtains, warm wooden flooring, and a retro sofa. The interior feels authentic, intimate, and lived-in.
Camera and Composition: Shot with a 24mm smartphone wide-angle lens from an extremely low, floor-level perspective. Her bent knees dominate the foreground, creating exaggerated perspective and a strong sense of depth while preserving natural anatomical proportions.
Visual Style: Y2K digicam aesthetic, early-2000s digital camera photography, slightly low-resolution digital texture, cool-toned direct flash, subtle digital noise, and an authentic candid snapshot feeling.
Lighting: Soft, misty white morning daylight filtering through sheer curtains, combined with subtle cool-toned flash illumination. Low-saturation colors with a delicate balance between cool and warm tones.
Overall Aesthetic: A relaxed, natural expression with realistic, finely detailed skin texture. Authentic knit fabric textures and natural clothing folds. A lived-in interior atmosphere, clear compositional depth, and anatomically accurate body proportions. Ultra-realistic photographic quality, high-definition details, intimate cinematic mood, and spontaneous everyday photography.
Constraints: Single subject only, natural body proportions, realistic anatomy, no extra limbs, no text, no watermark.
